ui_label: Horizontal grid cell with a unstructured grid type and 0.5 x 0.5 degree resolution.
description: For data submission, MATSIRO fields are remapped to the regular 0.5-degree latitude-longitude output grid g131. CaMa-Flood fields submitted as unit-catchment values retain their native catchment geometry. Both representations have a spatial resolution of 0.5 degrees.  The native ILS land grid contains 120964 distinct model cells with positive effective area: 94427 unit-catchment elements shared by MATSIRO and CaMa-Flood in the river-bearing domain, and 26537 additional non-river elements used only by MATSIRO for consistency with the ocean-derived land area on the atmospheric grid. The native grid has a horizontal spatial resolution of 0.5 degrees. The stated resolution does not imply that each native cell has a width and height of exactly 0.5 degrees. This resolution applies to the native unit-catchment representation as well as to the regular latitude-longitude representation used for remapped output. This is an unstructured collection of catchment and masked or weighted land elements, not a uniform rectangular physical mesh. Exchanges between MATSIRO and CaMa-Flood over the shared river domain use one-to-one cell correspondence without spatial remapping or aggregation. The 3600-second exchange interval, AVR and lag=-1 settings describe separate temporal treatment.
